q1_issues.issue: "Air Force" is a proper noun premodifying the common-noun head "major general", which the instruction set keeps outside Compound concepts; fusing it into air_force_major_general splits no name off, so the head should be major_general linked by (Possession bridges air_force).
No (Name air_force "Air Force") atom is emitted, so a named entity mentioned in the text carries no Name fact at all.

q2_gaps: a privative/temporal adjective on a predicate nominal ("a FORMER shuttle pilot") has no licensed encoding — the parse's (Past (Member bridges shuttle_pilot)) is a reasonable stand-in but is not the instruction set's surface-tense-decides rule, since the clause is present tense
notes: The coordinated predicate nominals are correctly two separate Member atoms, shuttle_pilot emits its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and the rank adjective "major" is correctly suppressed as failing the predication test.
